# Judy Martin

Judy Martin is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2000.

Judy Martin has participated in 7 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 with 64.1% of the ballot.
- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 with 56.9% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin#e12)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 with 51.3% of the ballot.
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 with 39.2% of the ballot.

## Election History

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Helier No 1](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier-no-1) (3 seats), 27th November 2002.

**Judy Martin was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 in 2002**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Patrick Ryan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/patrick-ryan)** |  | 720 | 69.9% |
| 2 | **Judy Martin** |  | 660 | 64.1% |
| 3 | **[Jerry Dorey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jerry-dorey)** |  | 488 | 47.4% |
| 4 | [Peter Pearce](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-pearce) |  | 352 | 34.2% |
| 5 | [Chris Whitworth](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/chris-whitworth) |  | 252 | 24.5% |

1,030 ballots (inc. 8 spoilt papers)

3,483 registered voters

= 29.6% turnout
